stem.text: A single-celled organism lives inside the body of a fish. This single-celled organism is rod-shaped, $700\,\mu\text{m}$ long, enclosed in a cell wall and has cytoplasm containing thousands of copies of small, circular DNA.
Which statement about this single-celled organism is correct?

A.text: It is a eukaryote, because it can be seen without using a microscope.

B.text: It is a eukaryote, because it is too large to be a prokaryote.

C.text: It is a plant, because it is enclosed in a cell wall.

D.text: It is a prokaryote, because it has small, circular DNA in its cytoplasm.
